notes:
ALERTS, on the home screen below AUDIT. It pulses red while something is unread, groups by date, and each one has a Resolve button that removes it for good.

The first thing it watches: a room move protel has no X against. With legacy mode off the tool now reads the move window too, and tells you about a move protel is not going to show you. It does not record the move itself — which room is the one being left is still not confirmed, and guessing that would put two wrong rooms in the ledger.

Also fixed: guest names now really do arrive uncut, and an unattended read that protel cut short is no longer written to the ledger.
